summary.en: The screen pushes to the region in play under the zoom cap while the device holds still; the light, the value, the line and the ring land in order; or a registered cut on the beat; or the claim landing on the bar line in a pause.
summary.zh: 设备不动，屏幕在缩放上限内推近当前区域；光、数值、说明、圆环依次落定；或在拍点上对位硬切；或主张在小节线上落定并停顿。

fits: One region of a real capture that carries the point: a picker, a number, a row, a price.
notFor: Text too small to read even at the cap (set it in the margin instead); two regions at once.

intent.en: The viewer is taken to the exact part of the real screen that proves the line beside it.
intent.zh: 把观众带到真实屏幕上证明旁边那句话的那一小块。

content.en: A capture with a named region (box, optional band); a value (≤ 10 chars / 5 字), a line (≤ 18 / 14 字), a note (≤ 40 / 22 字); for the claim a lead line.
content.zh: 一张带命名区域（方框，可选整行）的截图；数值（≤ 10 字符 / 5 字）、说明（≤ 18 / 14 字）、注释（≤ 40 / 22 字）；主张另加一行引子。

fits.zh: 真实截图上承载要点的那一块：选择器、数字、一行、价格。

notFor.zh: 推到上限仍看不清的字（改写进页边）；同时两个区域。

pairs.note: light the rows of the same capture next

en: Never push past 1.333 output px per source px; a soft capture reads as fake.
A cut needs two captures of the same screen; never draw the missing state.
zh: 推近不超过每源像素 1.333 输出像素；发虚的截图像假的。
硬切需要同一屏幕的两张截图；缺的状态不要画。

source.path: assets/templates/handset/choreo.js (TYPES.push, cut, claim), film.js (camera, light), moves.js (viewport-push)

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
